set.body:
Defect: Second half of the extraction; kept separate so each lands green alone.

Do: Re-point nfrd at the four primitives extracted in the parent bead. NfrdBaseballVerifier stays specialized and stays where it is.

Tests: Its existing receipt checksum is the parity oracle: NfrdBaseballReceipt.contentChecksum unchanged before and after. NB verifyReceipt (intake.scala:842) returns Unit.

Mutants (SD1 — each must die, recorded by name): change one extracted primitive's behaviour -> the NFRD receipt checksum must move.

Exit: Receipt-checksum parity recorded in the commit body. NB 'Verified now covers five corpora' is FALSE -- NFRD gets the primitives, not Verified, and stays off the critical path.

Plan: docs/plans/2026-09-17-annotation-intake-contract.md S0, third bullet
